title: rosa canina var. surculosa
intro: Rosa canina var. surculosa, commonly known as dwarf or compact wild rose, is a low-growing, thorny shrub that is a variety of the Rosa canina species. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. surculosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as vitamin C, flavonoids, and salicylic acid, contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
